sloka: क्रुद्धैस्तेरहमुत्प्लुत्य दृष्टमात्रः प्लवङ्गमैः ।गृहितोऽस्म्यपि चारब्धो हन्तुम् लोप्तुम् च मुष्टिभिः ॥६-२४-२९॥।।
transliteration: kruddhaisterahamutplutya dṛṣṭamātraḥ plavaṅgamaiḥ ।gṛhito'smyapi cārabdho hantum loptum ca muṣṭibhiḥ ॥6-24-29॥।।

translations.english: As soon as they saw me, the enraged Vanaras rising up (into the sky) took hold of me and started injuring me and slaying me.
